title: Version-locked crates break the fallback resolver
author: cuviper
body_preview: `serde_core` is version-locked to the same `serde_derive` via `target.'cfg(any())'.dependencies`. This is fine in theory, but they currently have different `rust-version` support, and Cargo's fallback resolver appears to be too greedy.  ``` $ cargo +1.70.0 new hello      Created binary (application) `hello` package $ cd hello/ $ sed -i '/^edition/a rust-version = "1.70"' Cargo.toml $ cargo +1.70.0...

title: Failure in deserializing #[serde(untagged)] enum should generate meaningful error
author: adityashah1212
body_preview: As title suggests, currently generates `data did not match any variant of untagged enum <Name>` error. This doesn't really give a lot of information as to why nothing matched. I believe just reporting all encountered errors for each variant would help define why each variant was rejected and allow the user to act upon it to fix the contents.

title: Create a de::ErrorKind and a kind method to de::Error
author: adityashah1212
body_preview: The problem with current `de::Error` is that is throws away the _kind_ information as by default everything boils down to `de::Error::custom` and in no way forces `de::Error` implementations to preserve this information. title: UniqueRc does not implement Serialize/Deserialize
author: blockmath
body_preview: Even with all features enabled (unstable and rc being the important ones), Serde does not implement Serialize + Deserialize for UniqueRc. I believe it should, as a regular Rc is serializable.

title: [Feature Request] Make `#[serde(rename_all = "")]` support independent number
author: TheCGDF
body_preview: For exampe, current snake case: ```rust #[derive(Serialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum Chapter {     Have1Apple, // will be "have1_apple" } ```  Hope something can do this: ```rust #[derive(Serialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case", independent_number = true)] pub enum Chapter {     Have1Apple, // want to be "have_1_apple" } ```
